decisions.reason: As a very recent launch in the firm’s core resin-processing equipment business, it is still an inexpensive option to keep open while market acceptance becomes clearer.
Because it is another newly introduced resin injection unit close to the firm’s technical base, management would likely continue observing demand before abandoning it despite some overlap risk.
An automatic airless spray gun fits tightly with the firm’s established spray-application portfolio, so the expected cost of keeping it is low relative to its learning value.
A manual airless spray gun is highly aligned with the firm’s existing capabilities and customer base, making early withdrawal unlikely after only one year.
As a multi-model product line in a core application area, it offers broad option value across customer segments and is unlikely to be removed so soon.
The data logger is somewhat more uncertain because it extends toward digital monitoring, but it complements the installed equipment base and is still worth keeping as an option.
